**Needs changes before merge** (two small items; the MCP work itself is sound).

**Real diff.** Head trial-merged with current `origin/main` cleanly (auto-merge of `mcp/job.rs`, `mcp/tools.rs`). `git diff origin/main <merged>` is only: `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs`, `mcp/job.rs`, `mcp/tools.rs`, `crates/app/tests/mcp_wire_contour.rs`, `docs/decisions/1108-mcp-wire-contour.md`. No product code outside the MCP layer changed; main's wire-contour operation, posting, stamp, tool gate, icons and goldens are untouched.

**What looks good**
- `add_operation` asks `KindInfo::mounts_tool()`; mill kinds still require `tool`, the Wire Contour takes none, a tool named anyway reaches `CreateOperation` and is refused in its words. Same undoable command as the GUI.
- `list_operation_types` reports `mounts_tool` plus a note; schema `required` is `["kind"]`, description and skill row match the tool.
- Condition/side/start refusals arrive as plain tool errors; undo/redo round trip is tested. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` added outside tests. `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1108` present.

**Local results (merged with main)**
| run | result |
|---|---|
| mcp_wire_contour | 3 passed |
| wire_contour | 7 passed |
| mcp | 18 passed |
| golden_cl | 26 passed |
| coarse_laws | 6 passed |
| posting | 17 passed |
| camcraft-app --lib | 147 passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is 31, the same as main (the PR's bump to 31 is now main's own number; the diff against main has no change to the file). The PR edits a process file (`.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`), so it must take the next number: set it to 32. The PR body and the #681 announcement line should say `PROCESS_VERSION 32`.
2. Issue #1108 asks that a wire contour still cannot post over MCP. No test pins it: `mcp_wire_contour.rs` never calls `post` on the wire document (the SKILL row claims "`post` fails by name"). Add a test in `crates/app/tests/mcp_wire_contour.rs` that, after generating the Wire Contour, calls `post` with an output path and asserts a tool error naming the wire/EDM refusal and that no file was written.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `add_operation` description in the PR body says "30 -> 31"; refresh it with item 1.
- Gate was not run via `cargo xtask`; I ran the suites directly as listed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
